records.why_it_looked_promising: |dF/domega| fell ~7 orders below the ~4.6 typical at a simple root, and |F| reached 1.5e-11 -- the signature of a near-double root.
records.rejection_reason: OUTSIDE THE VERIFIED NUMERICAL DOMAIN. r2 = 0.44 against a validated recurrence domain of r2 <~ 0.20 (slowly convergent beyond ~0.26); extremality M-(|a|+|b|)^2 = 0.0089, i.e. essentially extremal, where the asymptotic tail explicitly breaks down (c -> 0) and Solver C is untested. Newton also stagnated near 1e-6 rather than converging.
records.status: REJECTED - not evidence for or against an EP
records.what_would_settle_it: extend Solver C validation to r2 ~ 0.44 and near-extremal parameters, then re-solve the augmented system there with three independent solvers
